about: Prepare yourself to soar through the skies! ACE COMBAT 7: SKIES UNKNOWN puts you in the cockpit of the most advanced aircraft ever developed for a fierce flight shooter experience unlike any other. Take down the enemy to make it out alive.
- EXPERIENCE INTENSE DOGFIGHTING IN REAL AIRCRAFT
Aerial combat in ACE COMBAT 7: SKIES UNKNOWN combines realistic handling, extensive aircraft options, and blistering speed for a thrill that anyone can enjoy.
From the greenest pilot to the hardened maverick, taking to the skies in your choice of aircraft is a ferocious joy.

The vast selection of cutting-edge aircraft combined with future technology and weapons makes ACE COMBAT 7: SKIES UNKNOWN the most realistic experience possible. Each craft can be personalized with extensive parts and ordinance options.

Cutting through the deep blue with 360 degrees of maneuverability in pursuit of the enemy is an unforgettable high. Chase down your targets and launch attacks on land, sea, and air to dominate the skies!
summary: Become an ace pilot and soar through photorealistic skies with full 360 degree movement; down enemy aircraft and experience the thrill of engaging in realistic sorties! Aerial combat has never looked or felt better!
